'''2007 Pennsylvania State Championship Mike Gemme DS Invasion''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Mike Gemme]] at [[2007 Pennsylvania State Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Invasion / In Complete Control|Theed-D-invasion.gif}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' Michael Gemme
* '''Deck name:''' gemmelingus
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS13]]
